items.summary: Recommendation: continue containment-only execution; authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, or new queue work. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 56 improvements await measurement, 21 implementation requests failed, and operations/security sweeps have no results. Supported revenue is limited to Amazon data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to a site; site-attributed income is $0. Do not claim revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, forecast, or causal lift. September 1–29 AI spend is $934.99756275 across 5,174 calls, including 229 errors and 5 transient errors, but cannot be compared with one revenue day or treated as monthly run-rate. Budget exposure, infrastructure spend, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, revenue-floor, infrastructure-cost, labor/operating-cost, commitment, and approved learning-threshold data are absent. Continue the existing report-only CFO reconciliation using matching-period provider revenue, AI cost, infrastructure cost, operating cost, commitments, budget ceilings, and an approved cost-to-learn threshold when available; do not request duplicate telemetry or extrapolate.

Retain the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation only. Minimum evidence required to calculate contribution margin is site/content-attributed realized commission for the same period plus AI, infrastructure, labor, and other operating costs allocated on the same basis. Minimum evidence for cost-to-learn is a defined approved learning threshold, complete matching-period cost base, and attributable outcome. Minimum evidence for budget exposure is an approved monthly spend limit, committed spend ledger, and actual-to-date spend. Until those fields exist, preserve each result as unknown and treat clicks, sessions, impressions, ordered items, shipped items, AI calls, and proposal counts as operating or vanity metrics rather than financial outcomes.

Do not prioritize work by clicks, impressions, sessions, or opportunity scores alone. Re-rank only after site-level attribution and matching costs are available. Existing affiliate-path work may proceed later only with a pre-change baseline, named tracking identifier, attributable commission outcome, and rollback evidence. No forecast or investment case is supported by the current one-day Amazon result or September AI spend.
